manifesto.label: ABOUT THE STUDIO
manifesto.heading: Good sound is not an accident. It is a decision.
manifesto.p1: Pars Studios is an independent production studio based in Istanbul. We care about one thing: turning an idea into a record you feel in your chest. We do not chase trends — we build character.
manifesto.p2: Every project starts with intent before acoustics. We sit with the artist, talk about what the track wants to say, and only then open a microphone. We dislike rushing — because a rush can be heard in the recording.
manifesto.p3: Gear matters; the ear matters more. Here, equipment is a tool, not the hero. In the end only one thing remains: the silence in the room when the track plays.

items.quote: They didn't try to bend the song into something else. They listened, then made it land. The mix moves like the track was always supposed to.
Five hours in and we still hadn't opened a mic. That's the part most studios skip. By the time we tracked, the take was already there.
Mastering came back transparent — no over-cooked loudness, no lost air. It sat next to the references like it belonged.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: Two weeks is comfortable for mix and master sessions; one week is usually enough for tracking. For longer projects we plan multi-day blocks together.
Yes — 30% upfront to lock the date, balance on the day. We send a single invoice; bank transfer or card both work.
Cancel 48 hours before the session and the deposit is fully refundable. Inside 48 hours we can reschedule once at no charge.

items.q: What should I bring to a tracking session?
items.a: Your instrument, charged headphones if you use IEMs, reference tracks, and the stems or scratch you've been working on. We supply mics, preamps and the headphone mix.

items.q: Do you take remote mixing or mastering work?
items.a: Yes. Send stems or a stereo file via Drive or WeTransfer with a short brief and 2–3 references. Revisions and final delivery are handled over email.
WAV 24-bit at session sample rate, plus a streaming-loud reference MP3. Stems and tagged masters on request. Everything stays archived for 12 months.
